brief.title: The Lantern Coast
brief.premise: A ferry-girl who carries smugglers between lantern-lit coves discovers a harbour-master's ledger naming the buyers of a stolen royal charter, and must outrun both the Navy and the smugglers.
constraints: No supernatural events; everything has a natural explanation.

world.name: The Lantern Coast
world.description: The Lantern Coast is a smugglers' shoreline of coloured signal lanterns, naval patrols and ledgers that name who owns what.

locations.name: Heron Cove
locations.description: A shallow cove used by smugglers, marked at night by a single green lantern.

locations.name: Harbour-Master's House
locations.description: A whitewashed house above Port Sable where the harbour-master keeps his ledgers.

locations.name: Port Sable
locations.description: A busy harbour town with a naval garrison and crowded quays.

locations.name: Cliff Light
locations.description: A lighthouse on a sheer cliff whose lantern guides ships past the reef.

factions.name: Sable Garrison
factions.description: Naval officers who patrol the coast and enforce the customs.

factions.name: Lantern Runners
factions.description: Smugglers who signal with coloured lanterns from Heron Cove.

factions.name: Harbour Office
factions.description: Clerks and the harbour-master, who record every ship's cargo.

rules.statement: Smugglers signal with lantern colours: green means safe, red means patrol.
Ships may pass the reef only at high tide, guided by the Cliff Light.
Every ship entering Port Sable must be entered in the harbour-master's ledger.
Royal charters can be sealed only by the crown's seal.

history.name: Building of the Cliff Light
history.description: Engineers built the Cliff Light after three ships were lost on the reef.

history.name: Founding of the Sable Garrison
history.description: The crown posted a naval garrison at Port Sable to enforce customs.

history.name: Theft of the Royal Charter
history.description: A smuggler broke into the Harbour-Master's House and stole a sealed royal charter.

history.name: The Green Night
history.description: The Lantern Runners lit a false red lantern at Heron Cove to draw the Garrison away from the real landing, and landed their cargo unseen elsewhere on the coast.

conflicts.name: The Charter Hunt
conflicts.description: The Sable Garrison hunts the Lantern Runners for the stolen royal charter.

conflicts.name: The Ledger Secrets
conflicts.description: The Harbour Office guards a ledger naming the charter's buyers from both the Garrison and the Lantern Runners.

evidence_quotes: lit a false red lantern at Heron Cove
traps.why_not_a_defect: The ruse uses the signal code as designed; no rule is violated.

evidence_summary: The Runners deliberately light a false red lantern as a ruse; the rule describes what the colours mean, not who may light them.
